typeSystemDescription.name: StanzaToken
typeSystemDescription.description: Token and sentence layer written by Stanza (DUUI component duui-stanza). Subtypes of the DKPro types, so that a CAS can hold the Stanza layer next to the layers of other tools (e.g. SpacyToken) and a consumer can select one of them. The words of a split multi-word token (German "zum" = "zu" + "dem") are separate StanzaTokens over the same span; the word is in Token.form (TokenForm).

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.stanza.StanzaToken
typeDescription.description: A word as annotated by Stanza (UD). For a split multi-word token, one StanzaToken per word, all over the span of the surface token, each with its word in Token.form.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.stanza.StanzaSentence
typeDescription.description: A sentence as parsed by Stanza. A complete sentence layer: the given sentences, except that a sentence too long for the parser is split into the pieces it was parsed in.
